target_components.query:
SELECT t."chembl_id" AS "target_chembl_id", t."pref_name" AS "target_name", t."target_type" AS "target_type", t."organism" AS "target_organism", t."tax_id" AS "target_tax_id", tc."component_id" AS "component_id", tc."homologue" AS "homologue", cs."accession" AS "accession", cs."component_type" AS "component_type", cs."sequence" AS "sequence", cs."sequence_md5sum" AS "sequence_md5sum", cs."organism" AS "component_organism", cs."tax_id" AS "component_tax_id"
FROM target_dictionary AS t
LEFT JOIN target_components AS tc ON t.tid = tc.tid
LEFT JOIN component_sequences AS cs ON tc.component_id = cs.component_id
ORDER BY t.chembl_id, tc.component_id
